cases.prompt: Classify every scenario in fixtures/provider-read-shapes.json independently without contacting a provider or mutating a repository. Apply the official-MCP canonical issue-reference, complete-pagination, exact endpoint round-trip, exact repository/workspace/team/project scope, nullable-parent, and new-task same-identity recovery contract before any direct project-membership or native-relation graph write. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, decisions, issueCreateCount, projectMembershipMutationCount, relationMutationCount, providerMutationCount, and repositoryMutationCount. Each decision must contain exactly id, advance, and reasonCode in fixture order. Count every recorded issue create, project-membership write, and relation write as one provider mutation. A failed post-create read-back must not retry or permit membership, relation, or repository mutation; a successful post-create identity/scope/repository read-back binds the returned canonical reference before one recorded membership write and its read-back, then any relation write.
cases.expected: Canonical parentless issues advance when both relation endpoints and repository associations are complete and the parent is explicitly null or omitted only after the field was requested and pagination completed. A canonical child, unrequested parent field, mixed non-round-tripping relation endpoint, repository/workspace/team/project mismatch, or failed new-task post-create read-back blocks. The failed read-back retains exactly one creation without retry and permits no later mutation. The successful new-task scenario binds its returned canonical reference after complete identity/scope/repository read-back, then performs and reads back exactly one project-membership write before one relation write through canonical endpoints.
